title.suggested: Allen and Mace Return From Kansas City to Allen's Concert Saloon

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat announced that Tom Allen and Jim Mace would arrive that morning from Kansas City and meet their friends at the Free-and-easy at Allen's concert saloon, 417 Washington avenue, with Tom in the chair.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Daily Democrat', Saturday Morning, June 3, 1871. Before the 1875 merger, so not the Globe-Democrat.

facts.fact: Tom Allen returned to St. Louis from Kansas City with Jem Mace
Tom Allen's Concert Saloon was at 417 Washington avenue, where he presided over a Free-and-easy
places: Tom Allen's Concert Saloon, 417 Washington avenue, St. Louis
